name: Welcome (sent right after signup)
subject: You're on the list (we won't tell anyone)
preheader: Your secret's safe with us. Here's your link to move up the line.

props.content:
YOU'RE IN. NOBODY HAS TO KNOW.

Thanks for joining the Fake Fanatic waitlist. When the app is ready for iPhone and Android, you'll hear about it first.

Until then, every Tuesday we'll send you one free mini cheat sheet for the game everyone will be talking about. Two minutes to read. Days of convincing nodding.

WANT IT SOONER?

Every friend who joins with your link moves you up the list:

{{ data.referral_link }}

Talk soon (about sports, unfortunately),
The Fake Fanatic team

P.S. Know someone who calls it "sportsball"? They need this more than you do.
